Not to mention the fact that it’s an abject lie to say you can’t travel with your children.

@KatyTurNBC attacked @SpeakerJohnson this week after he quite literally just READ THE DECLARATION OF INDEPENDENCE in the middle of his prayer at @Freedom250's Rededicate 250 Event.

Yes, our rights come from God. No, they do not come from the government.

This didn’t used to be controversial 🙃

Pray for our country.

Little did they know it’d be heard by millions around the world instead.

The kids are alright 🤍

PURE FIRE🔥

Under the new “family law,” a girl’s silence is now considered full consent to marriage. The regime has ruled that if a “mature virgin” does not speak out, she has agreed to wed.

Such marriages can only be annulled after the girl reaches adulthood, and only through a Taliban court.

This is quite literally not an "impossible choice." NO ONE is forcing a "choice" to sell your 5 year old daughter into sex slavery - a father of Godly honor would rather sacrifice his own life to protect his beautiful daughter.

This is why it's important to remember that not every culture is equal, and why humanity will always fall short unless we are willing to reject sin and embrace the path to Sainthood through Jesus Christ.

Shame on @BBCNews for presenting this for anything less than what

The National Park Service, inspiring the entire concept of National Parks for the whole world, only exists because of conservative Teddy Roosevelt.

It was under Republican President Richard Nixon that the EPA was established, the Clean Air Act was passed, & the Endangered Species Act was passed.

… you’re joking, right?

has a single person in the history of humankind ever once associated the love of nature with the right? Is that something that has ever happened literally once at all?

During an abortion, "where do you think the baby goes?"

After traveling the country to speak out against abortion @KristanHawkins believes most young women have never thought about this question before--even if they'd have an abortion themselves.

Every year in America, 750,000+ women are giving birth to their babies on the toilet or in the bathtub after taking the abortion pill at home--and their babies' bodies are being flushed into our wastewater system.

Are abortion pills poisoning your drinking water?

What if I were to tell you that every time you fill up a glass of water at your kitchen sink from the tap, you were actually *drinking* someone else’s abortion—both the pills that started the process, and the human remains that were flushed down the toilet?

“What is an American?” @Brandon Gill weighs in 👀🇺🇸
We need more Brandon Gills in Congress 🇺🇸 @Brandon Gill joins the show today - interview dropping soon!! 🍿
Taking back the West, one cross at a time ✝️
Imagine being an award winning journalist who’s never read the Declaration of Independence 🫠
Go touch some grass today
Pray for these beautiful little girls.
This might be a new low for Congress, tbh. Full conversation with @Kristan Hawkins on the continued fight against abortion live now (🔗 in bio)
Or… maybe… we’re just tired of being told we aren’t allowed to think independently??!!??
*sighs again as a woman in America*
Every time you fill up your water at the sink, are you drinking someone’s abortion?
